steps.title: Coat 6-well plates with Geltrex
steps.instruction: Prepare Geltrex coating solution and coat 6-well plates.

substeps.instruction: Rapidly thaw Geltrex aliquot and dissolve in ice-cold DMEM (100ul of 15 mg/ml stock in 25ml DMEM for ~60ug/ml final concentration).
Distribute Matrigel-DMEM at 2ml/well of a 6-well plate.
Incubate plates in the incubator for a minimum of 1 hour to coat (do not leave more than 2-3 days before use).

steps.title: Seed NPCs
steps.instruction: Dissociate and seed NPCs into the coated 6-well plates.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate medium and add room temperature (RT) Accutase (1ml per well of 6-well plate).
Incubate in the incubator for 3-5 mins.
Collect cells using a P1000, gently pipetting 2-3 times to break clumps, and transfer to a 15ml tube containing DMEM at a ratio of 3 parts DMEM to 1 part accutase.
Centrifuge at 1000g for 5 mins.
Resuspend cells in 1ml of NPC medium using a P1000.
Count cells using a haemocytometer or Countess II if needed and dilute in NPC medium to the desired density.
Seed cells at approximately 1.5-2M cells/well (2ml NPC medium/well of a 6-well plate).

steps.title: Transduce NPCs with Lentivirus
steps.instruction: Transduce NPCs with NGN2-neo-GFP and rtta lentiviruses.

substeps.instruction: Check the condition of NPCs seeded at Day -2.
Prepare virus-containing NPC medium by adding 150ul of each virus (NGN2-neo-GFP and rtta) to 24ml of RT NPC media.
Aspirate medium from the plate and add the virus-containing medium (2ml/well of a 6-well plate).
Incubate the plate for 3-4 hours, then replace with fresh NPC media.
Prepare induction media consisting of NPC media supplemented with 1ug/ml doxycycline.
Perform a whole media change using this induction media.

steps.title: Select for Transduced Cells
steps.instruction: Apply selection media to the culture.

substeps.instruction: Prepare selection media using fresh NPC medium with 1ug/ml Dox and antibiotics (concentrations adjusted based on NGN2 vector resistance).
Perform a whole media change.

steps.title: Transition to Neuronal Medium
steps.instruction: Switch the cells from NPC medium to Brainphys neuronal medium.

substeps.instruction: Prepare Brainphys neuronal medium supplemented with 1ug/ml Dox.
Aspirate NPC medium and add the prepared neuron medium.

steps.title: Prepare 12-well plates for replating
steps.instruction: Coat 12-well plates with a higher concentration of Geltrex.

substeps.instruction: Coat 12-well plates at least 4 hours prior to plating (preferably the day before) using 4x Geltrex (400ul of 15 mg/ml stock in 25ml DMEM for ~240ug/ml final concentration).

steps.title: Replate NGN2 Neurons
steps.instruction: Dissociate immature neurons (between D5 and D7) and seed into 12-well plates.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate medium from NGN2 neurons and add RT Accutase (1ml per well of 6-well plate).
Incubate in the incubator for 5 mins until neurites retract.
Collect cells using a P1000, gently pipetting 2-3 times, and transfer to a 15ml tube containing DMEM at a ratio of 3 parts DMEM to 1 part accutase.
Centrifuge at 1000g for 5 mins.
Resuspend cells in 1ml of neuron medium using a P1000.
Count cells and dilute in NPC medium to the desired density.
Seed cells into 12-well plates at approximately 1.2M neurons/well (2ml NPC medium/well). Scale for 6/24/96 well plates if necessary.

steps.title: Remove Doxycycline
steps.instruction: Phase out doxycycline to prevent neurons from remaining in an immature state.

substeps.instruction: Remove half of the media and replace with fresh neuron media containing no doxycycline.

steps.title: Apply Ara-C Treatment
steps.instruction: Treat neurons with Ara-C to limit proliferation.

substeps.instruction: Perform a half-volume media change using 400nM Ara-C in neuron medium to achieve a final working concentration of 200nM Ara-C in the well.

steps.title: Maintain and Harvest
steps.instruction: Feed neurons and monitor for activity.

substeps.instruction: Feed neurons every 2-3 days until harvest.
Monitor for activity (typically appears by D21, with robust synaptic activity by D28).
